# ninesixteen.video

> Native 9×16 and 16×9 screen recorder for Windows. Record locally, frame with your cursor, export MP4 with Pro ($49 one-time). No subscription. No crop in post.

## Key facts

- **Platform:** Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
- **Formats:** True 9×16 portrait and 16×9 landscape — native aspect, no post crop
- **Framing:** Cursor-driven viewport, Alt + scroll zoom, rule-of-thirds guides
- **Audio:** System + microphone; optional mouse click sounds in recordings
- **Pricing:** Free to record and preview; $49 USD one-time for Pro MP4 export
- **Privacy:** Local-first, encrypted recordings on your machine
- **Tech:** Tauri + Windows Graphics Capture (not Electron); FFmpeg bundled
- **Virtual camera:** Appears as "ninesixteen.video" in OBS, Zoom, Meet
- **Latest version:** 1.1.0 (June 2026)
